name: Slayer Sicarius
body:
A sicarius is a church assassin that uses magic to complement his skills in finding and destroying heretics and blaspheme creatures.

Spellcasting

Starting at 4th level, a sicarius is able to cast a limited number of spells. The sicarius is a spontaneous caster, using the bloodrager’s spells per day and spells known. He draws his spells from the inquisitor spell list, and Wisdom is his casting stat.

This replaces the slayer talents gained at 2nd, 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th level.

Relentless (Ex)

At 13th level, the sicarius can travel for an extended period of time without rest. The sicarius (and his mount, if he has one) can walk 16 hours in a day of travel without it being considered a forced march, but at the end of that day, he must attempt a DC 15 Fortitude saving throw. If he fails, he can travel for 8 hours the following day, and he (as well as his mount, if he has one) is fatigued for the following 24 hours. If he succeeds at the saving throw, he can use this ability again the following day. The DC of the Fortitude saving throw increases by 2 for every additional day the sicarius has been traveling for more than 8 hours. The sicarius does not need to attempt a separate saving throw for his mount. After the sicarius rests for 24 hours, the saving throw DC resets to 15.

This replaces slayer’s advance. The sicarius can still get slayer’s advance by selecting it as an advanced slayer talent.

Slayer Talents

A sicarius has access to the following new slayer talents:

Lesser Inquisition

The sicarius gains the 1st-level power of one inquisition granted from his deity or philosophy.

Vampiric Focus (Su)

The sicarius gains one vampiric focus of his choice from the vampire hunter base class.

A sicarius has access to the following new advanced talents:

Greater Inquisition: The sicarius gains the higher-level power granted by the inquisition he selected with the lesser inquisition talent. The sicarius must be at least 8th level and have the lesser inquisition talent in order to select this one.
Improved Vampiric Focus (Su)

The sicarius gains a second vampiric focus from the vampire hunter base class. The sicarius must have the vampiric focus talent in order to select this one.
